notes: Windows beta update: fixed primary navigation for Chat, Activity and Task library; optional tools in a floating More panel with pins; paginated chat and workspace history instead of nested sidebar scrolling. NotzUp meeting and note jobs use qualified local models even when connected assistance is enabled, and note-linked conversations retain that local-only policy. Added the desktop-compatible S1–S4 device performance profile for the same Tiny-ALL speech pack and a project blueprint template in OYYO. Speech capture remains limited to 1 minute 55 seconds. Existing installation method, demo key and activation reuse are unchanged. Windows only; Mac feeds are unchanged.
